<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z 276.0666. Assuming this corresponds to the molecular ion (M⁺), the neutral mass is ≈276.066 Da. The formula C₁₄H₁₂O₆ has an exact monoisotopic mass of 276.0634 Da, matching the observed mass within a few ppm, making it the most plausible molecular formula.</thought>
<final_answer>C14H12O6</final_answer>
